items.title: 2020s in fashion
items.text: The fashion of the 2020s represents a style defined by short-lived social-media trends and nostalgia for older aesthetics. It has been largely inspired by styles of the late 1970s to late 1980s, the late 1990s to mid-2000s, and elements of Modern Medieval fashion, boho-chic, Indie sleaze and mid-century fashions from the 1940s, 1950s and 1960s. The early and mid 2020s were driven by microtrends, social media influencers, and niche online communities that transformed internet aesthetics into the dominant tastemakers for fashion. items.text: Fashion in the United States is eclectic and predominantly casual; emblematic garments include cowboy hats, boots, jeans, casual tailoring, and leather motorcycle jackets.
